names.title: Names to screen
names.description: Required unless datasetId is set. People or company names, e.g. ["Rosneft","Acme Trading LLC"]. Add " | Country" to flag country matches, e.g. "Vladimir Putin | RU". Objects work too: {"name":"...","country":"IR","type":"entity"}.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: Which official lists to check (default: all). Each is downloaded fresh from the government source on every run.

minScore.title: Minimum match score
minScore.description: 0-100 similarity needed to report a match (default 85). 92+ gives fewer, closer matches; 80 catches more spelling variants. Range 70-100.

entityType.title: Entity type
entityType.description: Only match listed individuals, only entities (companies, vessels, aircraft), or any (default).

maxMatchesPerName.title: Max matches per name
maxMatchesPerName.description: How many listed records to return per name, best first (default 5, max 25). matchCount always shows the total.

defaultCountry.title: Default country
defaultCountry.description: Optional country (2-letter code or name) used as the hint for names without " | Country". It only sets countryMatch; it never hides matches.

maxNames.title: Max names
maxNames.description: Screen at most this many unique names per run (default 10000). Aliases: maxItems, limit.

datasetId.title: Or: dataset ID from another Actor
datasetId.description: Optional. Read names from another run's dataset, e.g. a supplier or customer export. In an integration the triggering run's dataset is used automatically.

nameField.title: Name field in the dataset
nameField.description: Field with the name. Auto-detected from name, fullName, companyName, company, legalName, title and more. Dot paths work, e.g. "owner.name".

countryField.title: Country field in the dataset
countryField.description: Optional field with a country (code or name). Auto-detected from country, countryCode, nationality, location.

datasetMaxItems.title: Max dataset items
datasetMaxItems.description: Read at most this many items from datasetId (default 1000).

alwaysDownloadFresh.title: Always download fresh lists
alwaysDownloadFresh.description: Off (default): use the copy of each list downloaded from the official source within the last maxListAgeHours (refreshed every 6 hours), which makes runs fast. On: download every list from the government sites in this run (adds 1-2 minutes).

maxListAgeHours.title: Max list age (hours)
maxListAgeHours.description: Use the cached copy of a list only if it was downloaded from the official source within this many hours (default 24, min 1). Older lists are downloaded live.

downloadTimeoutSecs.title: List download timeout (seconds)
downloadTimeoutSecs.description: Per-file timeout for downloading a list (default 150). A list that cannot be downloaded is reported in listsNotChecked and its rows are not charged.
